source.description: Six-panel built-in image-generation contact sheet reviewed as one cumulative pencil process before cropping.
source.notes: The live US past-day Rising query 'how to draw a horse easy' was Breakout on 2026-07-27. The sheet must keep one calm near-front horse head, one left-swept mane, two ears, two eyes, two nostrils, and one long muzzle stable; no rider, tack, body, landscape, text, or final-only anatomy.

process_strategy: Lock the horse to one centered head axis and muzzle wedge, wrap the same guides with the complete head-and-neck silhouette, establish facial landmarks and every mane group, then add restrained graphite and chestnut pencil only to shapes already present.

final_elements.name: center axis, cranium oval, muzzle wedge, neck curves, ear guides, and left mane reserve
final_elements.description: Pale construction fixes one near-front head, the long muzzle taper, both ears, the neck opening, and the space reserved for a mane swept to the viewer's left.

final_elements.name: complete horse head, muzzle, two ears, neck, and mane silhouette
final_elements.description: One readable horse-head contour wraps the construction while keeping the two ear tips and swept mane footprint.

final_elements.name: two almond eyes, two nostrils, mouth seam, jaw planes, and ear interiors
final_elements.description: Paired facial landmarks sit symmetrically around the center axis without turning into glossy cartoon features.

final_elements.name: forelock and four broad flowing mane groups
final_elements.description: A small forelock and exactly four large, drawable mane locks follow the reserved left-side flow.

final_elements.name: graphite values, dark mane masses, restrained chestnut pencil, paper highlights, and broken cast shadow
final_elements.description: Visible handmade shading and restrained warm color clarify the already established head planes, mane, and neck.

frames.visible_job: Places the center axis, cranium oval, tapered muzzle wedge, neck curves, two ear guides, and the left-side mane reserve at one fixed scale.

final_step.visible_job: Only strengthens the established keeper contours, facial landmarks, four mane groups, graphite planes, chestnut pencil, paper highlights, and broken shadow.
allowed_changes: graphite value deepening on established planes

rejection_checks: No ear, eye, nostril, mouth seam, jaw plane, forelock, mane group, color area, highlight, or shadow may first appear in the final panel.
The head axis, near-front viewpoint, muzzle length, two ears, neck crop, and left-swept mane must remain stable in every panel.
Reject photographic anatomy, glossy eyes, individual rendered hairs, extra mane locks after step four, tack, a rider, a body, scenery, text, decorative borders, or vector-like linework.
Every dark pre-final contour must survive in the finish unless it is explicitly a pale erasable construction guide.
